summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now means finished_time is present; capture in Progress.update and Progress.advance under the lock; clear in Task._reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING annotation import); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, import, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns with hand-traced expected output: start frame bar width 25 with elapsed 0:00:37/0:00:36, final frames bar width 16 with elapsed 0:01:00/0:00:45 and speed 1 byte/s); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry). Verified by grep only: bar run lengths and elapsed cells in the expected line. Not verified by execution: test_columns expected output was derived by hand tracing the clock reads and could be wrong until the suite runs. Analysis suggests test_track, test_progress_track, and test_render output is unchanged. Not done: docs rst update (not requested), no commit.
